prompt: Write part of a deposition transcript (about 400 words) of a plaintiff in a car accident lawsuit. The defense lawyer asks (lines start with 'Q:') and the plaintiff answers (lines start with 'A:'). Accident: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. Ask about the accident, treatment and daily life. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you my initials for the record, if that's acceptable to you.

Q: That's fine for today. Where were you on the day of the collision?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, Texas, heading east on the main road. I had the green light.

Q: Describe what happened as you entered the intersection.

A: A pickup truck came from my right side, going through the cross street. I didn't see it until it was almost on top of me. I tried to brake, but there wasn't time. It struck the passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

A: No, I was awake the whole time. I remember the airbags going off and feeling my shoulder slam against the door frame.

Q: Did you seek medical attention that day?

A: Yes, the paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I went to the emergency room later that afternoon. They took X-rays and told me the shoulder was badly strained.

Q: What treatment have you received since then?

A: I've been going to physical therapy about three times a week. I also had an injection in the shoulder, and the doctor has talked about a possible surgery if it doesn't improve.

Q: How has the injury affected your daily life?

A: It's hard to do simple things. I can't lift anything heavy, so my grocery shopping has to be split into smaller trips. I can't comb my hair with my right arm without pain. I used to coach my son's soccer team, and I've had to step away from that.

Q: Have you been able to work since the accident?

A: I work in an office, so I've been able to keep working, but I can't type for long stretches. I've had to take some afternoons off for appointments, and some days the pain makes it hard to concentrate.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that shoulder?

A: No, not to my knowledge. I'd never had any real trouble with it before this accident.
